chains.label: Domain-Scan — full DRP posture in one governed turn
chains.desc: When a domain scan is requested, assemble its whole threat picture: deterministic risk grade, DNS/email-auth posture, and the remediation playbook — three declared reads, context (domain) threaded, 0 LLM tokens. Optional gated tail proposes continuous monitoring.

gatedTail.note: Gated write: the chain PAUSES here and proposes adding the domain to continuous monitoring. A read-chain may never silently start a write — the operator (or a principal holding the watch permission) approves. Denying stops the chain; the refusal is the safeguard.
